notes: These 25 script callbacks and their intrusive queue helper are reviewed C recovery, not compiler matches. Constructor bodies remain external.
Registration strings prove command bindings; runtime use of all retained AI/vehicle commands by this game is not yet established.
All callbacks retain two integer ABI arguments even when argc is unused: destination is passed in $5. Scalar float parameters use independent EABI float registers.
m2c 708d2d2 mipsee-gcc-c provided ignored research drafts. Manual review corrected omitted argc parameters, stale integer arguments, stack vector storage, and odd-FP-register conversion placeholders.
The candidate GCC 3.2.3 ABI saves callee registers with sd/ld where retail uses sq/lq; no nonleaf byte-match claim.
Float-to-signed conversions express the retail EE instruction via a target C cast; portable host behavior for nonfinite/out-of-range script inputs is not claimed.
